name: MiniCar Shop Simulator
storyline:
Live out your childhood dream and run a toy store! And not just any toy store - your store is dedicated to the ultimate toy beloved by children and adults alike - miniature cars! In MiniCar Shop Simulator you will collect and trade toy cars, expand and customize your shop, run deliveries on your scooter, and get up to lots of shenanigans!

In MiniCar Shop Simulator there's over 300 unique model cars from 9 different collections from urban and sports cars through utility vehicles, up to military machines and futuristic supercars. Open mystery boxes, find legendary cars, complete your collection, and earn big bucks trading rare models! Not fond of working the register? No problem. Hire a cashier!

Every shop can be expanded in size, furnished, and decorated to your liking. With lots of patterns to pick from, custom paint colors, and lots of decorations like neons, posters, and arcade machines there's just no limit in expressing your personality of your establishment! Posh boutique or nerd's paradise - the choice is yours.

There's 6 maquette tracks of increasing complexity and difficulty that you can put in your shop, and they're not just there for decoration. You can race against the clock on each of them with every single car available in the game (and each will offer different top speed, acceleration and so on). Try to get all the trophies, but look out for the crazy obstacles!

The race tracks are not the only place where you're going to be speeding. Clients will sometimes order from you online, and you'll need to deliver the goods directly to them. Get the required set of cars, pack them up, hop on your trusty scooter and get to the drop-off point as fast as you can. Yes, you can jump off ramps to get over obstacles. And you should.

Bored clients dancing in the queue? Being awarded points for lunging an empty box at the recycle bin (or someone's head)? People showing up in just their underwear in your shop on casual Friday? A dinosaur car? A mysterious graffiti? Mopping up barf? The game may be a retail sim, but you can always count on something fun and unexpected to happen.
summary: Have a great, silly time running a toy car store in MiniCar Shop Simulator! It's 50% Supermarket Simulator, 50% Mario Kart, 50% Goat Simulator, 50% gacha game, 50% NBA, 1% DOOM, and 99% certified STUPID.
